entities.name: 1-deoxy-D-xylulose-5-phosphate synthase
observations: The 640-residue query sequence exactly matches curated Swiss-Prot reference Q0C154 from Hyphomonas neptunium (100% identity and coverage; exact sequence hash match).
Catalyzes the acyloin condensation of pyruvate with D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate to form 1-deoxy-D-xylulose 5-phosphate and CO2.
EC 2.2.1.7; curated homologs bind thiamine diphosphate and Mg2+ and are homodimeric.
Sequence contains Pfam DXP_synthase_N (residues 10–281), E1_dh (108–185), Transket_pyr (318–479), and Transketolase_C (495–618).

entities.name: DXP synthase reaction
observations: D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + pyruvate + H+ → 1-deoxy-D-xylulose 5-phosphate + CO2; Rhea RHEA:12605.
This is a thiamine-diphosphate- and Mg2+-dependent acyloin condensation in the methylerythritol 4-phosphate pathway.

entities.name: MEP pathway
observations: DXP synthase catalyzes the first committed step of the methylerythritol 4-phosphate pathway, producing DXP from pyruvate and D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate.
